Precondition: App is installed on device, Device is switched on.
Steps:
1. Tap the app icon
2. Wait for app to load
3. Verify home screen appears
Expected Result: App launches successfully and displays home screen. No error messages.
Notes: Can be executed on Android device/emulator

Steps:
1. Open app for first time
2. Check if permission requests appear
3. Grant required permissions
4. Verify app continues loading
Expected Result: App requests necessary permissions (camera, storage if needed). Permissions are granted. App loads without interruption.
Notes: Check device Android version for permission behavior

Precondition: App is launched, Home screen is visible.
Steps:
1. Navigate to Products/Shop section
2. Scroll through products
3. Tap on any product to view details
4. Verify product details are displayed
Expected Result: Product details page is displayed with product name, description, price, and image.
Notes: Verify multiple products can be selected

Steps:
1. Select a random product
2. Check product name is displayed
3. Check product price is displayed
4. Check product image is displayed
5. Check product description is visible
Expected Result: All product information (name, price, image, description) is correctly displayed.

Steps:
1. Tap the Add to Cart button
2. Wait for confirmation message
3. Verify cart icon shows updated count
Expected Result: Product is successfully added to cart. Cart count increases by 1. Success message is displayed.

Precondition: App is on product browsing page
Steps:
1. Select and add product 1
2. Select and add product 2
3. Select and add product 3
4. Check cart icon count
Expected Result: Cart icon displays total of 3 items. All products are added successfully.

Steps:
1. Tap on cart icon
2. Verify My Cart screen appears
3. Verify all added products are displayed
4. Verify prices are visible
Expected Result: Cart screen opens successfully. All added products are listed with quantities and prices.

Precondition: Products are in cart and cart screen is visible
Steps:
1. View the cart contents
2. Verify Proceed To Checkout button is visible
3. Tap on Proceed To Checkout button
Expected Result: Proceed To Checkout button is visible. Clicking it navigates to the checkout/payment page.

Steps:
1. Tap on username/email field
2. Enter 'bod@example.com'
3. Tap on password field
4. Enter '10203040'
5. Tap Login button
Expected Result: Login is successful. User is authenticated. Logout option is visible in menu.

Steps:
1. Tap menu icon
2. Verify Logout option appears
3. Verify user is still on the page
Expected Result: Logout option is visible in the menu, confirming user is logged in.

Steps:
1. Tap on username field
2. Enter invalid email
3. Tap on password field
4. Enter invalid password
5. Tap Login button
Expected Result: Error message is displayed. User is not logged in. Stays on login screen.

Precondition: User is on checkout page after cart verification
Steps:
1. Verify Shipping Address section
2. Enter Full Name (random generated)
3. Enter Address 1
4. Enter Address 2 (apartment)
5. Enter City
6. Enter Zip Code
7. Enter Country
8. Verify all fields are populated
Expected Result: All shipping address fields are successfully populated with generated data. Fields display entered values.
Notes: Data is randomly generated per test run

Steps:
1. Enter all address fields
2. Proceed to next section
3. Return to checkout
4. Verify address data is retained
Expected Result: All previously entered address data is retained and displayed correctly.

Steps:
1. Verify all required address fields are filled
2. Tap Continue or Next button
3. Verify navigation to payment section
Expected Result: Navigation to payment section is successful. Shipping address section shows as reviewed.
Notes: Verify fields are required before proceeding

Steps:
1. Payment page loads
2. Card number is generated (starts with 4, 16 digits total)
3. Cardholder name is auto-filled (from shipping)
4. Expiry date is generated (MM/YY format, future date)
5. CVV is generated (3 random digits)
Expected Result:
All payment fields are populated:
- Card number: 16 digits starting with 4
- Cardholder name: matches shipping name
- Expiry date: valid future date in MM/YY format
- CVV: 3 digits

Steps:
1. Tap on card number field
2. Verify generated card number is displayed
3. Verify cardholder name field shows name
4. Verify expiry date is in correct format
5. Verify CVV field displays 3 digits
Expected Result: All payment fields display correctly generated data without errors.

Steps:
1. Locate billing address checkbox
2. Verify checkbox is available
3. Check/uncheck as needed
4. Proceed to review
Expected Result: Billing address checkbox functions correctly. Can toggle between checked and unchecked states.

Steps:
1. Verify all payment fields are populated
2. Tap Review Order button
3. Verify navigation to review page
Expected Result: Navigation to review order page is successful. Payment details are passed forward.

Test Case Name: Verify Shipping Details on Review Page
Precondition: User is on review order page
Steps:
1. Verify Review your order header is displayed
2. Check shipping name is visible
3. Check address line 1 is visible
4. Check city is visible
5. Check country is visible
6. Check zip code is visible
Expected Result: All shipping information from the checkout step is correctly displayed on review page.

Test Case Name: Verify Payment Details on Review Page
Steps:
1. Scroll down to Payment Method section
2. Verify card number is visible (with spaces: XXXX XXXX XXXX XXXX format)
3. Verify expiry date is displayed
4. Verify cardholder name matches shipping name
Expected Result:
Payment Method section shows:
- Card number formatted with spaces every 4 digits
- Expiry date in MM/YY format
- Correct cardholder name

Steps:
1. Verify all address information is visible
2. Verify all payment information is visible
3. Tap to scroll down if needed
4. Verify Place Order button is visible
Expected Result: Place Order button is clearly visible and accessible. All order details are confirmed.

Precondition: All review details are verified and button is visible
Steps:
1. Click on Place Order button
2. Wait for processing
3. Verify navigation to checkout complete page
Expected Result: Order is successfully submitted. Navigation to checkout complete page occurs without errors.

Precondition: Order is submitted and page loads
Steps:
1. Verify Checkout Complete header is displayed
2. Verify Thank you for your order message is shown
Expected Result:
Checkout Complete screen displays both:
- Checkout Complete header
- Thank you for your order message

Steps:
1. Check if order confirmation details are visible
2. Check if order number is displayed (if applicable)
3. Verify thank you message is clear
Expected Result: Order confirmation is properly displayed. Thank you message is clear to user.
Notes: Verify order number visibility if available

Steps:
1. Verify app returns to home or orders screen
2. Verify Cart is reset or cleared
3. Verify user can start another transaction if needed
Expected Result: Full end-to-end transaction is completed successfully. App is ready for next action.
